messages.procession.complete: The procession is in order. Head over to Ra on his throne.
messages.procession.start: The procession has stalled. Walk left and see what is wrong. Click on things to examine them.
messages.procession.kneel: The procession has arrived. Kneel before Ra as he sets.

procession.haul.instructions: Can you help us haul the bier? Heave with [space] when my whip falls. Wait for my count, then pull on each beat.
procession.haul.success: Well hauled! The sledge stands where it should, and the mummy goes on toward the tomb.

feedback.left_haul: Speak with the ox-driver when you are ready to return.
feedback.missed_beat: Missed a beat. Heave as the whip falls.
feedback.off_beat: Too %s. Heave as the whip falls.

find.default: Walk left to the stalled bier. Speak with the ox-driver beside the ox.
find.right: Walk right to the stalled bier. Speak with the ox-driver beside the ox.

pull.text: Heave with [space] as the whip falls. Too early or late makes the bier slip back.

procession.standards.instructions: Can you help us? Our standards are all mixed up. Drag each standard its rightful place.
procession.standards.success: All eight standards are in order.

feedback.empty_pole: Take a standard from another bearer first.

find.default: Click the group of eight standard-bearers to put their standards in order.

sort.text: The priest with two plumes reads the order. He stands beyond the offering table.
Jackal, ibis, falcon, bull, vulture, placenta, plumes, falcon: follow the procession from its front.

procession.offerings.instructions: Can you help restore the offering table? Drag items to their rightful place. I can help you if you get lost.
procession.offerings.success: The offering table is whole again.

feedback.missing_support: It needs support. Place the lower offerings first.
feedback.goose_on_table: The goose is not an offering for this table. Its bearer is beside the lector.

find.default: Click the collapsed offering table to begin rebuilding it.

build.text: Click the lector beside the table. He shows an offering you can place now.
Build lowest first. An offering falls if its support is missing.
Drag pieces above the upper shelf to clear space. They fall onto it; drag them back across to use them.

procession.goose.instructions: He hands you the loaf, looking forlornly at his empty hands.
procession.goose.success: He takes his goose back in his arms.

feedback.success_swapped: He takes his goose, letting the bread loaf fall.
feedback.success_carrying: He carries his goose with joy and purpose.
feedback.goose_refuses: He clings to his goose, refusing to give it up again.
feedback.holding_loaf: Odd that he's holding a loaf of bread.
feedback.wrong_item: This doesn't belong in his arms.

find.default: The goose-bearer holds a loaf. Take it, then find his goose among the fallen offerings.
find.empty: His arms are empty. He carried a goose; it must be among the fallen offerings.

return.text: The goose-bearer holds a loaf. Take it, then find his goose among the fallen offerings.

find_goose.text: His arms are empty. He carried a goose; it must be among the fallen offerings.
Find his goose among the fallen offerings.

procession.water.instructions: Can you help me pour? My arm is tired and the jar droops. Hold [space] to lift it, and keep the water running along the line.
procession.water.success: The water arches over Anubis and the mummy and runs down to their base.

feedback.pouring: The water runs along the line. Keep it there.
feedback.dripping: Too high: the jar only drips. Let it sink a little.
feedback.gushing: His arm droops too far: the water gushes out onto the woman's raised hands. Hold [space] to lift the jar.

find.default: Find the priest with a jar above a kneeling woman. Click him to pour the water.

pour.text: Too high only drips; drooped too far, the water splashes short. Keep the stream on its faint guide.
His arm droops faster or slower from moment to moment: watch it, and lift as it sinks.
Hold [space] to lift his drooping arm; let go to let it sink.

procession.bulls.instructions: Things are not in their rightful place. Examine each figure to see what's wrong.
procession.bulls.success: The plumed ox lowers his head to the calf. All three are as they should be.

feedback.plumes_restored: The disc and plumes sit on the living ox again.
feedback.calf_turned: The calf turns its back on the block and settles.

find.default: Something is wrong with the bulls near the sacrifice. Click one of them.

calf.text: Look at which way each animal faces, and what each one wears.
The calf is facing the sacrifice. Drag it sideways to turn it away.

plumes.text: Look at which way each animal faces, and what each one wears.
The disc and plumes are on the bull at the block. Drag them onto the living ox's head.

procession.opening_mouth.instructions: Help me finish his face. Click with the adze tip within the faint eye and mouth. [esc] steps away.
procession.opening_mouth.success: The words stand over Ra again, as they are written.

feedback.success_opened: You touch the adze to the mummy's mouth. Its mouth opens, and words come out.
feedback.adze_taken: You take the adze from the low table: a hooked blade on a long handle.
feedback.left_carving: We can try his face again when you are ready.

find.default: Take the hooked adze beside the obelisks and touch the mummy's mouth.
find.adze: Touch the adze to the mummy that Anubis holds upright.
find.words: Carry the words above the mummy to Ra, at the far left.

carve.text: Click rather than drag; touch the adze tip within the faint eye and mouth to finish them. [esc] steps away.

words.text: Carry the words to their faint outline over Ra, at the far left.

procession.offering_stand.success: The stand stands before Ra again, the sun disc on it and the lotus bending over it.

feedback.instructions_stela: Something stood here before Ra. The stela by the tomb shows what.
feedback.success_stela: The stand stands before Ra again, the sun disc on it and the lotus bending over it, as on the stela.
feedback.unsupported: %s has nothing to rest on yet.
feedback.unsupported_stela: %s has nothing to rest on yet. Look at the stela: something stands beneath it.
feedback.not_ready_to_collect: This might come in handy later, but you wouldn't want your hands full right now.

find.default: The stela beside Ra shows the missing offering stand.

collect.text: The stela beside Ra shows the missing offering stand.
Look behind the women mourners, on the bier, and on the offering pile for its three pieces.

assemble.text: Place the stand before Ra, then the sun disc, then the lotus.
